=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1335-1380 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: RB_HEAD_SHA can be accepted in uppercase but reused raw in the reissue-baseline branch name, so the consumer's lowercase-only regex rejects the branch and silently falls back to a redo.
  WHY: The producer validates uppercase hex and constructs a branch from `${RB_HEAD_SHA:0:12}` without lowercasing, while the consumer only matches lowercase hex, so an uppercase SHA would break spot-fix preservation at runtime.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1335 and 1376 | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
  PROBLEM: RB_HEAD_SHA is validated against ^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$ (accepts uppercase hex) at line 1335, but at line 1376 the baseline branch name is constructed using the raw slice ${RB_HEAD_SHA:0:12} without lowercasing.
  WHY: The consumer resolver in .github/workflows/implement.yml line 562 matches only lowercase hex with re.fullmatch(r"ai/reissue-baseline/pr-(\d+)-([0-9a-f]{12})-\d+-\d+", branch), so an uppercase headRefOid would cause the pushed branch to be rejected as untrusted and the preserved spot-fix baseline to be silently discarded.
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1376-1380 | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
  PROBLEM: The `RB_HEAD_SHA` is validated against regex `[0-9a-fA-F]{40}` which accepts both upper and lowercase hex, but the baseline branch is constructed using `${RB_HEAD_SHA:0:12}` without lowercasing.
  WHY: If GitHub API returns an uppercase SHA, the branch name becomes `ai/reissue-baseline/pr-42-ACDEFF123456-...`, and the consumer in `implement.yml` only matches lowercase hex, so the pushed baseline branch is rejected as untrusted and the spot-fix reissue silently falls back to redo mode.
=== END FINDINGS FROM moonshotai_kimi-k2_5 ===

=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
- scripts/review_rb_judge.sh:1376-1380 | ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
  PROBLEM: RB_HEAD_SHA validation accepts uppercase hex (`^[0-9a-fA-F]{40}$`) but the baseline-branch name embeds the raw 12-character prefix `${RB_HEAD_SHA:0:12}` without lowercasing.
  WHY: The consumer resolver in implement.yml:466-470 (`re.fullmatch(r"ai/reissue-baseline/pr-(\d+)-([0-9a-f]{12})-\d+-\d+", branch)`) only matches lowercase hex, so an uppercase SHA would cause the pushed baseline branch to be rejected as `untrusted` and the spot-fix reissue to silently fall back to a full redo.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_6-plus ===
